content.title: Asymmetric-Scale Pursuit | Narrow Evasion, Weapon Turn, Clash Threshold
content.summary: A rooftop courier evades a maintenance automaton and turns at a signal junction. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: Two roles have visibly different scale and mobility. + One continuous route remains recoverable. + Obstacles motivate every evasion. + Distinct color or prop anchors preserve each role. + Flight converts into a readable confrontation threshold.
quick_start.recommended_input: Place one adult rooftop courier with a narrow amber signal baton ahead of a towering maintenance automaton in silver rain. Use two ventilation housings and one gap to force the courier through readable lateral evasions. The courier plants the baton at the final junction and turns as the automaton reaches the same threshold.
required_anchors: Two roles have visibly different scale and mobility.
Distinct color or prop anchors preserve each role.
Flight converts into a readable confrontation threshold.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A rooftop courier evades a maintenance automaton and turns at a signal junction. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.

not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
